char_substitutions_notes._description: Single character substitutions. Apply ONLY in 紫微斗数 context. Many of these characters are valid Chinese in other contexts (e.g., 耀 is valid in 闪耀, 已 is valid as 已经). The cleaning pipeline must use term_corrections first (higher precision), then apply char_substitutions only within known astrology phrases.

_danger_chars.已→巳: 已 is extremely common; only replace inside earthly-branch contexts (e.g., 已宫→巳宫, 已时→巳时)
_danger_chars.己→巳: 己 is a valid heavenly stem; only replace when used as earthly branch
_danger_chars.西→酉: 西 is common; only replace inside branch-position contexts (e.g., 西宫→酉宫)
_danger_chars.耀→曜: 耀 is valid in non-astrology contexts; only replace in 星耀→星曜 etc.
_danger_chars.典→曲: Only replace in star name contexts like 文典→文曲
_danger_chars.康→廉: Only replace in star name contexts like 康贞→廉贞
_danger_chars.庚→廉: 庚 is a valid heavenly stem; only replace in star name contexts
_danger_chars.危→厄: Only replace in palace name contexts like 疾危→疾厄
_danger_chars.泊→帛: Only replace in palace name contexts like 财泊→财帛

regex_patterns.description: Remove standalone page numbers (e.g., '第123页', '42 页')
Remove lines containing only bare page numbers

regex_patterns.pattern: ([紫天太武廉贪巨七破左右文火铃擎陀地禄])\s+([微机阳曲同贞府阴狼门相梁杀军辅弼昌曲星羊罗空劫存])
regex_patterns.description: Remove spurious whitespace inside two-character star names (e.g., '紫 微' → '紫微')

regex_patterns.pattern: ([命兄夫子财疾迁交官田福父])\s+([宫弟妻女帛厄移友禄宅德母])
regex_patterns.description: Remove spurious whitespace inside palace names (e.g., '命 宫' → '命宫')
Remove whitespace in 四化 terms (e.g., '化 禄' → '化禄')
Collapse three or more consecutive newlines into a double newline
Remove Unicode replacement characters (U+FFFD) from OCR failures
Remove running headers containing book titles (e.g., '《紫微斗数全书》')
Rejoin hyphenated line breaks from column-wrapped OCR output
Remove circled number artifacts from OCR margin notes
Strip non-printable ASCII control characters injected by OCR
Remove excessive whitespace between CJK characters (OCR column gap artifacts)

usage_notes.priority_order: Apply corrections in this order: (1) regex_patterns to clean OCR artifacts, (2) traditional_simplified_map for traditional→simplified normalization, (3) term_corrections for full-term fixes (highest precision), (4) char_substitutions for remaining single-char fixes (use with caution, context-dependent)
usage_notes.context_sensitivity: Many char_substitutions are only valid in 紫微斗数 context. See char_substitutions_notes for per-character guidance on when NOT to apply a substitution.
usage_notes.bidirectional_warning: Do NOT apply char_substitutions globally. Always check if the source character is part of a valid non-astrology word first.
